entries.title: After an update, Firstmate on Claude works the new version's way
entries.body: When an update changes how Firstmate does something, such as showing you a card, Firstmate on Claude now starts a new conversation that knows what came before, and the activity feed says so. Before, it could keep working the old way until its next new conversation.
entries.noPicture: The only trace on screen is the activity feed's existing line saying Firstmate carries on in a new conversation; the change is in what a reopened Firstmate is told.
